inv.desc_en: AFFORDABLE 200M2 INDUSTRIAL UNIT FOR RENT IN EMPRESARIUM. Empresarium is a benchmark industrial area in Zaragoza. Corner unit for rent with 102m2 on the ground floor and 100m2 on the mezzanine. It is located in the Calle Retama, 17 complex (INBISA), next to the new Saltoki logistics center in the Empresarium Industrial Estate of Zaragoza. The most active area of the industrial park. It features a 24-hour video surveillance system. It has a small 20m2 office, a restroom, and a single-phase electrical installation. Excellent natural lighting and parking area. Separate doors for pedestrians and vehicles (4.50m high overhead door). Clear height of the unit on the ground floor: 4.70m. Call us for more information. We have an office in the same industrial park. Large professional team. We have the largest portfolio of industrial units in Aragon. In-house technical team for the study and analysis of utilization, property viability, urban planning regulations, valuation, and appraisal. GTI, advising individuals and companies since 1990. We help our clients choose the option that best suits their needs, 35 years of experience in the real estate sector. Information and commercial conditions without contractual validity. Offices: This property has a space designated for offices for the proper management of your business, providing a centralized space for administration and staff. Restrooms/Services: For greater convenience, this property has restroom facilities and essential services, thus promoting a healthy work environment. Mezzanine: Take advantage of the vertical space with a mezzanine that gives you additional storage or production options. Electrical Installation: Ensure the electrical safety of your operations with a certified installation that complies with all regulations.
